evidence: The three briefs and reported symptoms are supplied by the owner. Caption prose and provider candidates below are synthetic mocks, not recovered live provider responses. Earlier fixtures remain unchanged.

examples.body:
There is always another perspective to explore.

That is what I love about YouTube.

examples.source: Why are hashtags not working on my posts?
examples.body:
Hashtags are not the whole strategy.

What is the post saying, and who is it for? Those questions deserve attention too.

examples.source: Why do I love the different coloured lights in my room so much?
examples.body:
Same room, different colours.

There is something lovely about coloured lighting. Room lighting can be part of the atmosphere, not just the background.
